verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync is the vendor's own add-on that privately syncs notes across devices. Its docs say end-to-end encryption is the default and guarantees that no one, not even the Obsidian team, can access your notes. A community user also reports relying on the sync service for their notes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of the end-to-end encryption claim, explicit documentation of which device platforms Sync supports.

support.subject: As a power-user, an official sync service keeps my notes updated across all my devices with end-to-end encryption the vendor can't read

citations.quote: Obsidian Sync is an add-on service that allows you to privately sync your notes across devices.
End-to-end encryption (default) offers the strongest security
This guarantees that no one — not even the Obsidian team — can access your notes.
Obsidian Sync encrypts your remote vault and all communication with Obsidian's servers.
